units.source_text: 千重子一走进神苑入口，一片盛开的红色垂樱便映入眼帘，仿佛连心里也开满了花似的。

en.t: As soon as Chieko entered the shrine garden gate, a sweep of red weeping cherry blossoms in full bloom came into view, as if flowers had bloomed even in her heart.
Ah! This year I have made it in time for spring in Kyoto again.

units.source_text: 她赞叹了一声，就一直伫立在那儿观赏。

en.t: She let out a sigh of admiration, then stood there for a long while, gazing at the blossoms.
